children.text: This video is from the archive s Gombe Stream National Park, where we unveil an adorable behavior: an infant chimpanzee named Ferdinand engaged in play with a juvenile baboon. Interspecific play, or interactions between members of different species, is a unique and intriguing phenomenon in the world of animal behavior.
